day_shape: Strait of Hormuz tanker incident confirmed by UKMTO as limpet-mine attack with IRGC claiming three tankers hit and a US sea drone downed (CENTCOM denies), Qatari mediators return to Tehran as Vance offers to meet Mohsen Rezaei, State Dept posts fresh SDN designations, and IDF reports killing Hamas commander Ihab Abu Taqiya.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker and drone incidents
threads.summary: UKMTO said a small boat planted two explosive devices on a tanker causing an engine-room fire, while the IRGC and army navy claimed seizures and strikes on tankers and a US sea drone over Qeshm. CENTCOM called the IRGC sea-drone claim false, saying all US unmanned surface vessels in the region are accounted for.

threads.label: Qatari mediation and Vance-Rezaei channel
threads.summary: Qatari mediators returned to Tehran a day after their proposal was reportedly rejected, with Washington Post reporting Vice President JD Vance offered to meet SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei. Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir made a second Tehran visit this month, and Iran International reported Tehran holding firm on preconditions.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and West Bank arrests
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas squad commander Ihab Jamil Abu Taqiya in a Nuseirat strike involved in holding 12 hostages including Emily Hand and Raya Rotem, plus four Hamas operatives in Khan Younis and Rafah and two weapons depots in Bureij and Gaza City. Four former Jenin terror network members were apprehended in the West Bank.

threads.label: Yemen, Houthi strikes and Saudi airspace
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported the US ordered non-emergency personnel out of Saudi Arabia over Houthi airport attacks, and Defa Press and IRIB claimed Yemeni advances in Taiz and Lahj and explosions in Aden. IRIB reported aircraft circling Dammam unable to land at King Fahd International.

threads.label: Iran NPT withdrawal and domestic posture
threads.summary: IRIB said the parliamentary national security commission spokesman reported at least 10 bills on the agenda for Iran's withdrawal from the NPT, and President Pezeshkian said Iran must be strong enough to deter covetousness. IRGC supreme adviser Negadi toured south-eastern borders in Sistan and Baluchestan.

threads.label: US sanctions and Pentagon planner fired
threads.summary: The State Department published fresh SDN List designations via the Federal Register. The Jerusalem Post reported Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth fired Pentagon top military planner Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia for leaking classified information on Iran and Ukraine.

threads.label: UN rights briefings and Iran crackdown
threads.summary: The UN Palestinian Rights Committee held its 431st meeting with briefings from Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese on humanitarian conditions in Gaza and the West Bank. Iran International reported a Baha'i photojournalist sentenced to 26 years was denied a standard appeal.
